QuestInfo.name: The Legendary Being's Scroll 3
QuestInfo.0: I gave #t4031432# to #b#p2091001##k of #b#m250000000##k. Hopefully now he'll lend me #t4031431#. I better go see #p2091001# right now.
QuestInfo.1: #p2091001# met his end of the bargain and lent me #b#t4031431:##k. Now it's time for me to deliver it to #b#p2071010##k.
QuestInfo.2: I gave #p2071010# the #t4031431#. Hopefully this will help #p2071010# become the Master at the intermediate level. Does that mean the intermediate-leveled Master can make not just the Gold Axe, but a Diamond-studded Axe?

0.0: Oh, you must be the person that helped my old student out the other day. Thank you very much for giving me #t4031432#. I found #b#t4031431##k for my other student, so please take this.

yes.0: So one of my students is being #b#p2071010##k at #b#m222000000##k... interesting. Should I visit him? Please let him know that he'll need to read #t4031431# and reach the medium level of the course to become the Legendary Being.

no.0: Hmph? You didn't take the item that you are supposed to deliver. Is there anything going on?

1.0: Ohh... this is #t4031431#! You must have visited #m250000000#. And you even gave the master my best wishes. Great job, my friend... great job. Here's a Gold Axe for your stellar... hmmm. Regrettably, I do not think I can reward you with a Gold Axe. The price of gold has been skyrocketing these days, and... Hmph. I apologize.

yes.0: Hmmm... The introductory level was difficult, so how hard would the medium level be... Let's see... Oh, this looks difficult, as expected. What? The master is coming? When will I be able to master all this??

npc.0: Hmm? Why are you just standing around here? I have lent you #b#t4031431##k, so please take it and go see #b#p2071010##k.

item.0: You're not at #m250000000#, yet? #p2091001# of #m250000000# is indeed, my master. Please lend this copy of #t4031431# to him.

lost.0: Ahh, you're here now. The Legendary Being's Scroll may be lost, but everyone visits the Legendary Being. Here's the #b#t4031431##k, so please take this to the #bMountain God#k.
